purpose: Freeze the remaining P4.3 implementation semantics that materially affect >1 economics before any 1.10/1.20/1.30 historical result is generated.

properties: cap=1.00 implies leverage_multiplier=1.0 for every defensive state and therefore exact frozen-BRRK identity
frozen_defensive_scale=0 implies final_scale=0 regardless of candidate cap
for fixed cap, leverage_multiplier is nondecreasing in frozen_defensive_scale
for fixed cap, final_scale is strictly nondecreasing in frozen_defensive_scale
candidate cap is reached only when frozen_defensive_scale=1
because base P3.2 gross is <=1 and multiplier <= candidate cap, final gross cannot exceed candidate cap
multiplier_policy.rationale: Use the already-frozen defensive output as the sole risk-state input to the new leverage layer. The policy introduces no thresholds, no second alpha model and no post-result optimizer. Extra leverage fades continuously as the defensive layer de-risks.
forbidden_inputs: raw HMM state labels or posterior probabilities beyond their already-frozen effect in defensive_scale
historically selected threshold or hand-picked date
multiplier_policy.candidate_evaluation_rule: Evaluate the exact same frozen formula separately for the preregistered caps 1.00/1.10/1.20/1.30. Do not optimize a continuous cap and do not alter the formula after observing candidate results.

search_unlock_conditions: P4 cap=1 exact historical parity is merged
P4.3 Hyperliquid cross-margin liquidation model passes official-formula and frozen-tier tests
this multiplier policy/addendum passes contract tests and is merged
no >1 historical candidate result existed before this addendum freeze
post_result_rule: Any material change to the multiplier formula, allowed inputs, margin mode, collateral assumptions or liquidation equations after a >1 result is observed requires a new experiment ID; LEVERAGE-0040 may not be rescued by amendment.
